title: Python: self.__class__ also refuses when an in-repo descendant of the enclosing class binds __class__ (DEC-303 (a58) items 2, 3 and 4)
description: DEC-303 (a58) items 2 to 4, from the Opus round 2 of opum-ai/glyph-cli#194 (TS, GCLI-119), which landed with this gap known and named. (a23) item 3: a class that defines __class__ leaves self.__class__ unresolved; self in an instance method of C may be an instance of any descendant of C. (a56) refuses the x.__class__ form when the enclosing class or an in-repo MRO entry binds __class__ (src/python/calls.ts localClassOfReceiver); this task extends the same refusal to any in-repo DESCENDANT of the enclosing class that binds __class__ in its scope, as an attribute, a property or a method. The polymorphic flag is not used. type(self) is unaffected (type() never consults __class__). A descendant outside the repository cannot be seen, the same limit self.m() has. The __getattribute__ blind spot is NOT part of this ((a57) item 4). Item 3: the lone nonlocal-moved binding that resolveAliasCall refuses (calls.ts, binding.origin check, kept under DEC-303 (a40) item 4: a moved write may not be the last one assigned, round 2 review of GCLI-113) while TS does not. glyph-cli finding at filing: no input could be built for the TS form, because Python requires an enclosing binding for a nonlocal name, so the moved write always arrives as a SECOND binding and TS already refuses it (refusedCases: a nonlocal write that is itself type(self)); an origin refusal in TS was a mutant that survived and was removed as dead code. Status: named, not queued, unless an input is built. If one is built and TS resolves it wrongly it is a defect and joins this task and the hold; if TS already answers correctly it gets a fixture only. Record only on filing; the fix is a later change under this task, joins the hold list of (a49) item 7 beside GCLI-120, and lands before the freeze.

acceptanceCriteria.text: a descendant of the enclosing class that binds __class__ as an attribute, as a property and as a method each makes self.__class__ refuse: a refused fixture per form asserting no edge and the exact bin delta, and the type(self) twin of each resolving with the callee pinned, red before and green after
positive twins: a descendant that does not bind __class__, and an unrelated class that does, still resolve self.__class__
a mutant that ignores descendants is observed red against the fixtures

the five-pin corpus diff (flask 49943b5a, httpx 7cff5f79, jinja 5ef70112, rich 3a109ccd, tqdm 9cf5a12b) is script-asserted against dev; it can only remove edges, and any site that moves is reported to opum-doc before the clear

(a58) item 3: the ruling behind the resolveAliasCall nonlocal refusal is named in the record ((a40) item 4) and an input for the TS form is tried: if one reproduces and TS resolves it wrongly it is fixed here with a fixture; if TS already answers correctly it gets a fixture only; if no input can be built it is named, not queued

implementationNotes: Item 3 measured (DEC-303 (a58) item 3; the origin refusal in resolveAliasCall is the one kept under DEC-303 (a40) item 4, round 2 review of GCLI-113). Inputs tried on dev e1dc2fc: an outer parameter, an outer plain assign, an outer for target, an outer del, two levels of nesting, the call in the outer and in the inner function, and an outer binding that is itself C.m. Every nonlocal-moved write arrives as a SECOND binding (Python needs an enclosing binding for a nonlocal name), so f() is refused by the bindings.length !== 1 count (nameNotBound 1, no edge to C.m) on dev and after; TS answers the same. Removing the binding.origin check changes no output on any of these inputs (identical output hash), so it is not reached by an input I could build. No wrong edge, so no fix and nothing queued; the origin check is left in place. Pinned as five refusal fixtures plus a single-binding control in test/python-hops.test.ts.
finalSummary: Landed as opum-ai/glyph-cli#212 (squash 78396339) after Opus round 1 BLOCK at 926a9e9 and round 2 APPROVE at bbd29313. self.__class__ in an instance method of C refuses when an in-repo descendant binds __class__ (attribute, property or method), when a mixin on a descendant's MRO does, or, per DEC-303 (a68), when a descendant's MRO does not compute or holds an opaque non-builtin entry (mock.Mock, an imported mixin); type(self), self.m() and cls.m() are unaffected, and an unshadowed builtin base still resolves. Verified by fixtures red on dev and green after (each delta measured by running both), twins, and mutants M-a to M-h, M-count observed red. Item 3 (DEC-303 (a58) item 3, the origin refusal kept under (a40) item 4) was measured only: every nonlocal-moved write is a second binding refused by the binding count on dev and after, removing the origin check changes no output, so no fix and nothing queued; five refusal fixtures, a sixth case that pins the count, and a control are in test/python-hops.test.ts. Five-pin corpus output byte-identical to dev (sha256 4839ad00c598e09909a8ed7f6f3f2450ef91502b8cde22d71c5ea0bbbba7c9ce).
